MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the Current Market Regime?
NEUTRAL: normal volatility at 33.0% and mixed breadth, with 3/8 sectors positive. Breadth remains narrow despite strong gains in transportation and banking.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Transportation leads (1W: +10.14% | 1M: +12.97%): PGSUS (1W: +15.01% | 1M: +16.48%) ABOVE TREND and THYAO (1W: +8.07% | 1M: +10.15%) ABOVE TREND. Banking & Finance is also firm (1W: +7.12% | 1M: +5.26%), led by GARAN (1W: +12.58% | 1M: +19.26%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology & Telecom is weakest on the week (1W: -2.81% | 1M: -0.01%), BELOW TREND; KONTR (1W: -10.70% | 1M: +6.90%) is in CORRECTION. Retail & Food (1W: -1.88% | 1M: -10.51%) and Energy & Chemicals (1W: -1.31% | 1M: -15.17%) are also BELOW TREND.

STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
PGSUS (1W: +15.01% | 1M: +16.48%) ABOVE TREND, GARAN (1W: +12.58% | 1M: +19.26%) ABOVE TREND, THYAO (1W: +8.07% | 1M: +10.15%) ABOVE TREND, TAVHL (1W: +7.35% | 1M: +12.29%) ABOVE TREND, and YKBNK (1W: +7.13% | 1M: +7.68%) ABOVE TREND.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
SOKM (1W: -15.62% | 1M: -20.66%) BELOW TREND, KONTR (1W: -10.70% | 1M: +6.90%) CORRECTION, HEKTS (1W: -8.74% | 1M: -21.96%) BELOW TREND, ULKER (1W: -7.64% | 1M: -14.93%) BELOW TREND, and KRDMD (1W: -7.06% | 1M: -13.94%) BELOW TREND.

6. Momentum Stocks?
PGSUS (1W: +15.01% | 1M: +16.48%) ABOVE TREND leads weekly momentum, followed by GARAN (1W: +12.58% | 1M: +19.26%) ABOVE TREND and THYAO (1W: +8.07% | 1M: +10.15%) ABOVE TREND. These moves are confirmed by positive monthly returns.

SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Banking Sector Outlook?
Banking & Finance is ABOVE TREND on sector returns; GARAN (1W: +12.58% | 1M: +19.26%), YKBNK (1W: +7.13% | 1M: +7.68%), and AKBNK (1W: +6.95% | 1M: +3.58%) are also ABOVE TREND. ISCTR (1W: +5.67% | 1M: +7.09%) and TSKB (1W: +6.67% | 1M: +6.13%) confirm broad participation.

8. Industrial Sector Outlook?
Heavy Industry remains BELOW TREND as a sector; FROTO (1W: +6.85% | 1M: -0.68%) and TOASO (1W: +2.88% | 1M: -10.32%) are in RECOVERY. EREGL (1W: -0.94% | 1M: -16.12%) is BELOW TREND, while ASELS (1W: -2.97% | 1M: +0.44%) is in CORRECTION.

9. Energy & Chemicals Outlook?
The sector is BELOW TREND (1W: -1.31% | 1M: -15.17%); SASA (1W: -5.45% | 1M: -16.58%) is BELOW TREND. TUPRS (1W: +1.53% | 1M: -9.42%) is in RECOVERY, while SISE (1W: -1.01% | 1M: -6.28%) remains BELOW TREND.

PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Maintain a balanced, selective stance under NEUTRAL conditions: favor strength in transportation and banking, while keeping exposure measured given only 3/8 sectors are positive. Avoid chasing sharp weekly rallies and require follow-through before adding to recovery trades.

NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
PGSUS (1W: +15.01% | 1M: +16.48%) ABOVE TREND and GARAN (1W: +12.58% | 1M: +19.26%) ABOVE TREND for continuation; TAVHL (1W: +7.35% | 1M: +12.29%) ABOVE TREND for transport-sector confirmation. FROTO (1W: +6.85% | 1M: -0.68%) RECOVERY is a rebound test, while TUPRS (1W: +1.53% | 1M: -9.42%) RECOVERY needs sustained follow-through.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
Monitor Transportation and Banking & Finance for leadership durability, alongside Construction & REIT (1W: +3.09% | 1M: -8.92%), which remains in RECOVERY. Watch whether breadth expands beyond the current 3/8 positive sectors.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
XU100 support and resistance levels were not provided, so avoid assigning numeric levels; track the index’s next support/resistance test and whether breadth improves. Key triggers are follow-through in transportation and banking, plus stabilization in lagging energy, retail, and technology names.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL conditions persist with normal 33.0% volatility but narrow breadth at 3/8 positive sectors. Transportation and banking offer the clearest relative strength, while weak monthly trends across energy, retail, and much of heavy industry remain the principal risk.
